title: Lost a word on a long page? Find it in 1 second 🔍 #Shorts
description:
Scrolling forever to find one word? Press Ctrl+F, type it, and your browser jumps straight to it.

⌨️ Windows: Ctrl + F
🍎 Mac: Cmd + F

Works in browsers, PDFs and many documents. Press Enter to jump to the next match.

A new life-saving tip every day, in 15 seconds. Save this for later and subscribe 🔔

#techtips #lifehacks #productivity #shorts #ctrlf #shortcuts
